note: The anniversaries worth a feed post. Keyed by the exact publication date: worthiness depends on the year (a 60th, a 250th), not only the calendar day. A listed date ships its event as the 'on this day' still on Instagram and Facebook, and the anchor pick is forced to that event. An unlisted date ships no anniversary post at all: the slot takes a second data card instead. Pinterest pins are search objects, not feed posts, so they keep their own draw. Candidates come from `npm run social-anniversaries`; the score proposes, this file decides. The bar: would someone outside the nation stop scrolling for it, or does the nation have a large audience that marks the day? Recently told stories (a reel in the past ~30 days) are left out.
